item.title: GI Joe and Paranormal Activity Get New Official Release Dates from Paramount
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: GI Joe casting/news and streaming clickbait.] Paramount reveals the release date for Danny McBride's GI Joe reboot and delays the next installment in the Paranormal Activity series.
item.content:encoded: Paramount Pictures has announced that Danny McBride's G.I. Joe reboot is expected to premiere in movie theaters in late 2028. Unfortunately, not all news is good; Paramount has also pushed back the next installment in the Paranormal Activity horror series by six months.

item.title: One Of Hollywood's Biggest Stars Just Auditioned For James Bond
item.dc:creator: Tomas Franzese
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: James Bond casting gossip without substance.] Robert Pattinson might be our next James Bond, according to new reports about the next James Bond film
item.content:encoded: As auditions for the next James Bond continue, new names are emerging and revealing which actors are up for the role. The latest on this from The Hollywood Reporter was particularly surprising, as it revealed some A-list Hollywood talent screen-tested for 007.

item.title: Ridley Scott’s R-Rated Sci-Fi Masterpiece is Officially Being Cut From Netflix
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming clickbait: 'leaving Netflix' deadline list format.] Alien and Aliens are leaving Netflix on Dec. 1, giving subscribers limited time to stream Ridley Scott’s sci-fi classics.
item.content:encoded: Ridley Scott has directed some of the most iconic science fiction movies of all time, from Blade Runner to The Martian. However, few have had the same lasting impact as his 1979 sci-fi horror classic Alien. The film helped redefine the genre by combining the terror of a slasher movie with the vast, isolating setting of outer space, introducing audiences to one of cinema's most memorable monsters in the process.

item.title: 10 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics About Cows
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgic retrospective filler about decades-old comic strip.] Gary Larson's The Far Side often featured cows in funny situations. Here are the 10 funniest examples
item.content:encoded: From 1980 until 1995, cartoonist Gary Larson wrote and drew The Far Side. It was a single panel comic strip filled with non-sequitur, surreal jokes mostly aimed at adults instead of children, which was unusual for newspaper comics at the time. Also unusual was the fact that, unlike most daily comic strips, The Far Side had no recurring characters. Peanuts has its gang of kids and Garfield has its cast of humans and animals, but every panel of The Far Side introduces new characters and scenarios all aimed at delivering one single joke.

item.title: Sydney Sweeney's New Netflix Sci-Fi Epic Is Mandatory Viewing For Transformers Fans
item.dc:creator: Collier Jennings
item.description: [Filtered: Anime news (Gundam); Transformers is big-franchise churn.] Robots (not) in disguise.
item.content:encoded: Transformers is a franchise that has built-in appeal in more ways than one. Apart from the concept of giant robots transforming into vehicles, there's the fact that two factions of these robots have been engaged in a war that spans millenia. There have been highs (including the grossly underrated Transformers One) and lows (including most of Michael Bay's films), but it's more than likely that we'll be seeing Transformers stories until the heat death of the universe. Netflix is aiming to deliver its own take on another property that features giant robots, and it's tapped Sydney Sweeney to play a leading role in this potential franchise.

item.title: 5 Sci-Fi Series To Watch If You Love HBO's 'Lanterns'
item.dc:creator: Collier Jennings
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn: DC/Green Lantern streaming recommendation list.] In brightest day, in blackest night, find your next binge watch tonight
item.content:encoded: HBO's Lanternsmore than delivered when it comes to being both a great comic book series and a great piece of television. Not only did the series thrive thanks to the dynamic between Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) and John Stewart (Aaron Pierre), but it also managed to revitalize interest in the Green Lantern franchise following the less-than-stellar Green Lantern movie from 2011. That's a superhuman feat in and of itself, and Lanterns creators Damon Lindelof, Chris Mundy, and Tom King deserve credit for pulling that off.

item.title: 38 Years Later, Calvin and Hobbes' Lost Character Remains Bill Watterson's Biggest Failure
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Nostalgia retrospective about old comic strip character from decades ago.] Uncle Max died on his way back to his home planet
item.content:encoded: The author Lois McMaster Bujold has said that “the writer should always reserve the right to come up with a better idea.” That's a useful guideline for any reader to keep in mind. As any long-form story evolves, it usually picks up a few dead plot branches or abandoned characters, because the author can exercise their option to drop what they're doing for any (or no) reason. Sometimes it's not a continuity error; it's a deliberate change in direction.

item.title: Ryan Gosling is Officially Reviving The Flintstones for New Project
item.dc:creator: Willa Rowe
item.description: [Filtered: Generic nostalgic reboot of old IP; not prestige or genuinely anticipated.] Ryan Gosling and Warner Bros are developing live-action Flintstones reboot about Bamm-Bamm
item.content:encoded: Ryan Gosling has been incredibly booked and busy of late. He starred in the lead role in the sci-fi smash hit Project Hail Mary earlier this year. In 2027, he'll travel to the galaxy far, far away in Star Wars: Starfighter. Then in 2028 he'll make his long-awaited MCU debut as Ghost Rider, re-teaming with Starfighter director Shawn Levy. If all that wasn't enough, Gosling has lined up one more unexpected project: The Flintstones.

item.title: Every GTA Game, Ranked by Metacritic Score
item.dc:creator: Jen Glennon
item.description: [Filtered: Ranking list/tier list format; Steven tosses these per taste profile.] With plenty of Grand Theft Auto games earning Metacritic scores in the high 90s, GTA 6 has an exceptionally high bar to meet.
item.content:encoded: With plenty of installments boasting Metacritic scores in the high 90s, GTA 6 has an exceptionally high bar to meet. That said, the series has had occasional growing pains over the years, even if true stinkers are a rarity among Rockstar Games’ back catalog. These are the top 10 GTA games of all time, ranked according to their Metacritic scores.

item.title: All Happy Mask Shop buyer locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide walks you through each step of Ocarina of Time's Happy Mask Shop quest, including who gets the Spooky Mask, Skull Mask, and Bunny Hood
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's Happy Mask Shop quest sends you around Hyrule peddling masks to specific customers. That sounds like a cushy gig, except you have very little guidance about who your customers are, and you occasionally even have to pay back the cost of the mask, too. However, if you want a big chunk of cash and a chance to see and hear everything in Ocarina of Time, it's worth the hassle.

item.title: Where to get Epona in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Epona is your horse in Ocarina of Time, but they're only available after you get a bit older. Here's where you can find Epona, and how to unlock her.
item.content:encoded: Epona is your trusty steed in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. Hyrule Field is a large zone, and running across it can take a long time. So, speed up the process a bit by calling Epona to your side. However, you'll need to wait a bit before you can ride her.

item.title: 10 New Movies to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, Prime Video, and Peacock (November 6 - 8)
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Generic streaming roundup; lacks substance or prestige projects.] On this weekend's movie column, there's a Bonnie and Clyde-like action thriller, a documentary, and much more.
item.content:encoded: Happy weekend! It’s a good one for new movie releases, from genre offerings to independent films that could be award contenders in the coming months. Godzilla Minus Zero is finally out, with our review calling it the best Godzilla movie of all time, an endorsement that should send any Polygon readers straight to their nearest movie theater. In independent cinema, there’s Club Kid, which has inspired award buzz and is out on limited release. Ramayana: Part 1, the latest Indian cinematic epic, is also currently in theaters and earning strong reviews (just make sure to watch the full Hindi version, not the shortened English dub).

item.title: All Big Poe locations in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Big Poes are ghosts that you can collect and sell in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find them and every reward you'll receive for turning them in.
item.content:encoded: Big Poes are large ghosts that are hiding around Hyrule Field in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. Like regular Poes, you can store Big Poes in bottles, and sell them to the Poe Collector in Hyrule Castle Town. However, Big Poes are worth a whopping 30 rupees, so if you collect them all, you'll get a good chunk of change.

item.title: Where to get an offering fish for Jabu-Jabu in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide shows you where to get an offering for Jabu-Jabu in the Ocarina of Time remake without having to spend rupees
item.content:encoded: You need to make an offering to Jabu-Jabu in Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake before you can rescue Princess Ruto. However, the game is rather vague about what constitutes an offering, though Jabu-Jabu's more devoted followers do give you a hint. Assuming you look in the right place, that is.

item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, HBO, and Apple TV (November 6 - 8)
item.dc:creator: Maria Loreto
item.description: [Filtered: Generic TV roundup with anime; lacks prestige or horror content.] In this week's TV column, we have a new anime series, a returning sports drama, and a cooking documentary starring a famous comedian.
item.content:encoded: Happy weekend! It’s an important month for some of the year’s biggest TV genre releases, from the new season of The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power, which has been billed as a soft reboot, to the final season of Yellowjackets, to Netflix’s new exorcist-teen horror comedy The Body.

item.title: All songs in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Songs are essential to progress in The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time. Here's all the songs and how to unlock them.
item.content:encoded: Songs allow you to change the time of day, call your horse, literally teleport, and much more in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Timeremake. They're essential to your progress, and they're just great melodies to listen to. However, all the songs are not available to you at the start of the game. Instead, you'll need to progress in the story, and scour all of Hyrule to unlock them all.

item.title: Where to find Princess Ruto in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's where to find Princess Ruto in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake in the "Spiritual Stone of Water" quest.
item.content:encoded: Finding Princess Ruto is part of the "Spiritual Stone of Water" main mission in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The Princess of the Zora Domain is missing, and her father, King Zora asks Link for help locating her. To complete this quest and progress through the campaign, Link must play detective and collect a few pieces of information to discover where he needs to go, which involves obtaining the Silver Scale to reach Lake Hylia.

item.title: All soft soil and Magic Bean planting locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Soft soil is where you can use bugs and Magic Beans in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find every pile of soft soil.
item.content:encoded: Soft soil and Magic Beans go hand-in-hand in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You can place a bug onto soft soil, and a Gold Skulltula will pop out. But, you can also plant a Magic Bean into it as young Link, and return to it in the future to go on a whimsical journey and find some secret goodies, like Gold Skulltulas and Pieces of Heart.

item.title: All Gold Skulltula locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Gold Skulltulas are a collectible in Ocarina of Time, but they're also needed for a cursed family. Here's where to find every Gold Skulltula.
item.content:encoded: Gold Skulltulas act as a collectible in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but they're also needed to cure a cursed family in Kakariko Village.

item.title: Pokémon Go Wild Area Gigantamax Machamp Timed Research and rewards
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Ahead of the 2026 Pokémon Go Wild Area event, we've got free Timed Research that rewards a G-Max Machamp. Don't forget to claim it!
item.content:encoded: The 2026 Pokémon GoWild Area in-person events are kicking off in Sendai, Japan and Mexico City, which means that even us global players not attending get a treat: a Gigantamax Machamp Timed Research set.

item.title: When is the next full moon for Ursaluna in Pokémon Go?
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's a schedule of the next full moons so you can evolve your Ursaring into Ursaluna in Pokémon Go.
item.content:encoded: If you want Ursaluna in Pokémon Go, you'll need to evolve your Ursaring on specific evenings. Ursaring only evolves into its grizzly evolution, Ursaluna, when there's a full moon in real life! Full moons occur once a month, so if the full moon passes, you'll need to wait another month or so to evolve it, sadly.

item.title: How to get Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon in Pokémon Legends: Z-A
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Game Freak is handing out Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon for the first time in 10 years. Here's how to get Poké Ball Vivillon in Pokemon Legends Z-A
item.content:encoded: Game Freak and The Pokémon Company are distributing a Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon in Pokémon Legends: Z-A, now that players have worked hard enough to unlock it. It's the first time in 10 years that pattern of Vivillon has been available, and all you need to do to get it is claim it from Mystery Gift. Scatterbug and Spewpa are comparatively easy to get early in Legends: Z-A, though this one is special.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide lists all keys that can be found in Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode and where to use them.
item.content:encoded: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: Keanu Reeves Officially Returning as John Wick in New Movie
item.dc:creator: Austin Manchester
item.description: [Filtered: Big-franchise churn about anticipated but generic action franchise.] Keanu Reeves will star in an animated John Wick prequel movie. John Wick 5 is also in development.
item.content:encoded: Though John Wick seemingly met his end in John Wick: Chapter 4, Keanu Reeves isn't done with his stylish assassin character just yet. A fifth John Wick live-action movie is in development, and director Chad Stahelski is also working on an animated prequel film. Now, Reeves is officially confirmed to return for it.

item.title: Tim Burton's Forgotten 10/10 Fantasy Masterpiece is Officially Still Free on Streaming
item.dc:creator: Brian VanHooker
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming availability clickbait; not a prestige or anticipated project.] Perhaps it's underrated because it barely even feels like a Tim Burton movie, but Big Fish is one of the director's best
item.content:encoded: When the conversation turns to Tim Burton’s best movies, the same titles tend to surface: Beetlejuice, his Batman movies, Edward Scissorhands, Ed Wood, and Pee-Wee’s Big Adventure. Even The Nightmare Before Christmas usually gets a mention, despite being directed by Henry Selick. Less likely to enter the discussion is Big Fish, Burton’s 2003 fantasy about a father whose life sounds too extraordinary to believe. That’s a shame, because it’s some of his very best work. It's also available to stream for free right now on YouTube and Tubi.

item.title: 49 Years Later, Steven Spielberg’s Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Free on YouTube
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.category: Close Encounters of The Third Kind
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: streaming clickbait headline] The aliens are coming and they're driving Richard Dreyfuss insane
item.content:encoded: Most creators are lucky if they ever make one truly revolutionary thing in their lives. Steven Spielberg has made at least six.

item.title: Classic Halo Trilogy Gets Brand-New Release on Nov. 10
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Graphic novel/book promo material, not video game news.] Halo’s Master Chief Omnibus arrives November 10, 2026, collecting three bestselling novels that expand the franchise’s lore.
item.content:encoded: It's been a busy year for Halo fans, with plenty of new releases and surprises keeping the franchise alive. Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the original game, is bringing Master Chief's first adventure to a new generation, while a tabletop adaptation is also in development. Even Halo Infinite isn't quite ready to call it quits, continuing to receive unexpected updates this year despite its major content support coming to an end.

item.title: All Great Fairy's Fountain locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Great Fairy's Fountains will provide you with magic and abilities in Ocarina of Time, as long as you have the funds. Here's where to find them.
item.content:encoded: Great Fairy's Fountains are home to, well, Great Fairies in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The Great Fairies are your gateway to magic and abilities. They'll give you spells that let you create fire, teleport in and out of dungeons, and grant yourself temporary invulnerability.

item.title: How to find Richard the dog in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's how to find Richard in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and how to identify the white dog to complete the mission.
item.content:encoded: Finding Richard is a side quest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You might have seen Richard, the adorable dog, during your first visit to Hyrule Castle Town: a white energetic dog that you couldn’t pet because its owner would accuse you of trying to steal her dog. If you visit the town again later, you will learn that Richard has disappeared.

item.title: 3 Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Movies You Can Stream For Free This Weekend (Novemeber 6 - 8)
item.dc:creator: Rachel Leishman
item.description: [Filtered: Generic streaming list; no substance or prestige projects.] Looking for the best science fiction movie to watch? Here are three options to choose from!
item.content:encoded: Science Fiction as a genre is one that fans get to explore in many different ways. Whether it is a horror movie or a comedy, elements of science fiction can turn a story into something so memorable for fans. And sometimes, you just want to watch a movie that has something a little more to it for you to unpack. The problem is trying to figure out what the best science fiction movie is to watch and with a large library of the genre online, picking the best of the best isn't easy.

item.title: James Cameron’s Avatar Franchise Gets a Massive New December Release
item.dc:creator: Sam Hill
item.description: [Filtered: Avatar is big-franchise churn; collector's edition release lacks substance.] Avatar: Fire and Ash gets a new 4K Blu-ray Collector’s Edition in December, featuring more than six hours of previously unseen bonus content.
item.content:encoded: James Cameron is giving Avatar: Fire and Ash another home-video release, and this one comes with enough behind-the-scenes material to keep Pandora fans busy for several hours. 20th Century Studios has announced a new Collector's Edition 4K Blu-ray, arriving this December, with more than six hours of previously unreleased bonus features.

item.title: Zelda Ocarina of Time guides and walkthroughs
item.dc:creator: Polygon Staff
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Making your way through The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Nintendo Switch 2? Here's a plethora of guides and walkthroughs to use.
item.content:encoded: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Nintendo Switch 2 is more than just a graphical overhaul of the game. Some of the puzzles you may remember from the original game have been changed, and Link can even jump now. Rather than racking your brain trying to remember how you beat the Water Temple back in 1998 (or perhaps 2003 or 2011), let us guide the way.

item.title: Fortune treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.dc:creator: Julia Lee
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Here's what time you can expect the next batch of Fortnite treasure hours, as well as what bonuses are coming with them.
item.content:encoded: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season, though this time they're treasure hours, centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: Cucco locations in Kakariko Village in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Josh Broadwell
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] This guide shows you were to find all the Kakariko Village Cucco locations in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
item.content:encoded: Finding The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's Kakariko Cucco locations seems like a chore too bothersome to deal with. A farmer lost her seven chickens, and she wants your help finding them and bringing them back to their little fenced-off area. She's got a very good reward for you, though, so the task is definitely worth your time, even if it isn't the most straightforward to complete.

item.title: All Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart locations in Ocarina of Time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart give you more health in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find all of them, so you can max out your health.
item.content:encoded: Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart are collectibles that increase your max health in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

item.title: Pokémon's 30th Anniversary UPC Release: Target vs. Best Buy
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/restock story; falls under toss category.] Pokémon's Eevee-themed UPC will be hard to buy unless you know how retailers like Target and Best Buy are handling the tricky release
item.content:encoded: As Nov. 6 nears, many Pokémon Trading Card Game fans are trying to decide how to best approach release day for the 30th Anniversary'sUltra Premium Collection. The product, which comes with 30 packs and two exclusive cards, isn't cheap — and most retailers won't be getting much stock. If you're truly intent on getting the UPC on day one, though, you're probably debating between a Target store versus a Best Buy location. Each retailer will handle the UPC's release a little differently.

item.title: Major Pokémon Center TCG Orders Delayed At The Last Minute
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG retail/fulfillment issue; not game-related Pokémon content.] Pokémon TCG fans who pre-ordered Delta Reign ETBs still haven't been charged, and TPC has not issued shipping updates
item.content:encoded: Pokémon Trading Card Game fans have spent the last couple of days feeling anxious. Delta Reign, the next big TCG set, releases on Friday — and The Pokémon Center hasn't updated anyone about their orders. Typically, the official Pokémon storefront charges for pre-orders a few days before release; shipment updates tend to come the day before launch. It turns out the lack of communication reflects an actual, active issue with orders.

item.title: 5 Gripping Detective Books That Are Page-Turners From Start to Finish
item.dc:creator: Debopriyaa Dutta
item.description: [Filtered: Generic book list, not game or horror-related content.] A fast-paced detective story is often the antidote to a tiring day
item.content:encoded: Everyone loves a great detective book. These stories satisfy our natural curiosity for solvable mysteries, allowing us to slip into the shoes of competent detectives like Sherlock Holmes, Hercule Poirot, and Benoit Blanc. There’s a sense of satisfaction to following a trail of clues, identifying red herrings, and theorizing before the answers are revealed. Good detective stories use grounded settings to heighten anxiety and embrace some amount of chaos before bringing about a neat resolution.

item.title: Where to find the Tokyo House in Forza Horizon 6
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Tokyo House is the most expensive player home in Forza Horizon 6. Here's where to find it and what perks it comes with.
item.content:encoded: The Tokyo House is a player home located in Tokyo City in Forza Horizon 6. Each home in Forza Horizon 6 provides you with benefits, and the Tokyo House has one of the best overall. Unfortunately, the Tokyo House is also the most expensive house, unless you have a VIP membership, which makes the house free.

item.title: Summer Tokyo City region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The summer treasure hunt is located in the Tokyo City region of Forza Horizon 6. Here's its exact location and how to reach it.
item.content:encoded: The summer Tokyo City region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6Series 7, "City Life." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: All active Escape From Tarkov codes and rewards
item.dc:creator: Ford James
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] A guide listing all currently active promo codes for Escape From Tarkov and how to redeem them.
item.content:encoded: Escape From Tarkov promo codes are used in the classic extraction shooter for all sorts of rewards. From in-game gear and weapons to currency, cosmetics, and more, redeeming as many of these Tarkov codes as you can will set you up for your next raid. Especially since these goodies don't actually require a successful extraction to obtain them.

item.title: Andy Weir's New Sci-Fi Epic is ‘The Martian’ Meets ‘The Twilight Zone’
item.dc:creator: Sam Nelson
item.description: [Filtered: Book promotion and excerpt, outside gaming/horror scope.] The time travel story Exoplanet launches on Audible on Nov. 5. Here's n exclusive preview
item.content:encoded: Andy Weir is known for his dramatic sci-fi survival stories The Martianand Project Hail Mary, which were both adapted into blockbuster films. His latest project combines the same focus on action and ingenuity, but with a more surreal concept that feels straight out of The Twilight Zone. Weir is executive producing Exoplanet, a full-cast audio experience written by Benjamin Percy for Audible. It follows the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder as they are scattered across time, landing on the same planet in different eras. The thriller releases on Nov. 5, and Audible provided Polygon with an exclusive clip following Science Officer Logan Bowers (John Leguizamo of The Odyssey) as he wakes up injured and desperately tries to find help.

item.title: How to unlock the true ending in Phantom Blade Zero
item.dc:creator: Paulo Kawanishi
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] In this guide, you learn the prerequisites to unlock the true ending in Phantom Blade Zero.
item.content:encoded: Phantom Blade Zero's true ending is called "Final Battle". You can experience four different endings, but this is only one that will connect all the dots, allowing you to gain a better understanding of the story. You will need to complete a list of side quests before reaching the last boss fight if you want to see what the developers consider the perfect ending to Soul's journey.

item.title: Constantine Movie Reportedly in the Works at DC Studios
item.dc:creator: Ashely Claudino
item.description: [Filtered: DC movie news without substance; franchise churn casting gossip.] Reports indicate DC Studios is bringing Francis Galluppi on board to write a Constantine movie.
item.content:encoded: Francis Galluppi, writer and director of Evil Dead Wrath, has reportedly been brought on board to write a Constantine movie for DC Studios. It is currently unknown whether this film is a sequel to Constantine (2005) or a completely new adaptation of the comic, but the latter seems to be the likely case.

item.title: Everything Is Dissapointing After Pokémon's Spectacular 30th Anniversary TCG Set
item.dc:creator: Patricia Hernandez
item.description: [Filtered: Pokémon TCG set review; trading-card retail content not games.] The Rayquaza-centric Delta Reign TCG set, which releases on Nov. 6, set never stood a chance against Pokémon's remarkable 30th Anniversary set
item.content:encoded: There's nothing wrong with the set. In any other scenario, Delta Reign would be a highlight of a busy TCG release year. Unfortunately, Pokémon's new TCG set is dropping after one of The Pokémon Company's best — if not the best — set releases ever.

item.title: 11 Years Later, Patrick Stewart's Near-Perfect Siege Thriller Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.dc:creator: Thomas Hindmarch
item.description: [Filtered: Streaming availability clickbait about old film, despite horror tag] Check out one of Stewart's rare villain roles in Jeremy Saulnier's grimy crime film
item.content:encoded: The late Patrick Stewart made much of his reputation off playing unique heroes and memorable protagonists. If there's one thing that connects Captain Jean-Luc Picard with the "Fox-verse's" Professor Charles Xavier, it's that both characters could be described as idealists, though they take distinctly different approaches thereof.

item.title: 10 Ocarina of Time beginner's tips that will save you some time
item.dc:creator: Johnny Yu
item.category: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is as challenging as ever. Here are 10 beginner's tips and tricks that will help you save the world.
item.content:encoded: The original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a tricky and difficult game, especially so when it first came out. The Ocarina of Time remake follows in the same footsteps, but just a bit more modernized. Some puzzles and quests are a tad easier now, but that doesn't mean you'll have a nice stroll through the Lost Woods. Ocarina of Time is still a challenging game that will put your brain to the test.

item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] Ganondorf's Castle is the final dungeon in Ocarina of Time. Here's how to break the barriers and defeat Ganon, so you can save Princess Zelda.
item.content:encoded: Ganondorf's Castle is the final dungeon in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, and you'll need to use everything you've learned from the previous dungeons to reach Ganondorf and save Princess Zelda.

item.description: [Filtered: Rule: category "Guides"] The Spirit Temple will force you to travel through time in Ocarina of Time. Here's how to complete the dungeon.
item.content:encoded: The Spirit Temple is another dungeon that you take on in the future in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You're sent to the Spirit Temple to find for Nabooru, the Gerudo's exalted leader.
